batting.name: SR Watson
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b S Aravind

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: run out (AB de Villiers, KB Arun Karthik)

batting.name: J Botha
batting.dismissal: c KB Arun Karthik b S Aravind

batting.name: LRPL Taylor
batting.dismissal: c M Kaif b CK Langeveldt

batting.name: AL Menaria
batting.dismissal: c M Kaif b CH Gayle

batting.name: TM Dilshan
batting.dismissal: c LRPL Taylor b SK Warne

balls.text: great last over from Zak. Full again, Yagnik swings and misses and they sneak a bye
full in the blockhole and those are just impossible to get away. Yagnik can't even get on bat on ball
looking for a big heave-ho and missing completely, bottom edge through to the 'keeper as they scramble for one
no slog this time, played down to mid-off where AB does the fielding again, he has been everywhere in this innings
full and Raut makes some room for himself, wants to slog and gets it as far as mid off
anging in, off the pads to fine leg
The umpire thinks the over is over but he has forgotten about the no-ball, Gayle comes back and bowls another one in the block hole
hurls down a yorker, well dug out
quicker again Gayle fires it in down the legside and the keeper can't make his way to the left fast enough and it's gone to the rope
quicker from Gayle and dabbed to backward point
played over Gayle' who gets fingertipd to it and donw to long off

It's coming apart for Rajasthan. Menaria hits that down Kaif's throat at ling-on. Nothing spectacular about the catch but there didn't need to be. Too easy for Kaif and not enough meat on it from Menaria
smacked to long off and AB de Villiers shows why he shouldnt be a wicket-keeper. Puts in the slide and cuts off a certain four
fired in at the legs and flicked to deep square leg
and this time Menaria goes for it. Slower ball and short, Menaria pulls and pulls powerfully, over deep mid on and its one bounce over the ropes
full again, but Raut is taking him on, comes down the track and slashes to third man
yorker from Langers at the end, as expected. Swings in and Raut has to dig it out. He does so, back to Langers, who fields off his own bowling
full ball, thrashed away and it goes as far as cover
Langers does it and he is pointing to AB in celebration. Slower ball and taylor slog swept to Kaif at deep backward square. He was looking to clear the rope but didnt get enough height on it
banged in short, Taylor looks for the pull but the ball is past his right shoulder before he can get it away
slower ball and tapped to deep midwicket, Kohli doesn't allow a second at all, charging in to pick it up
turned through mid-wicket, cut off by the fielder there
short ball, Menaria lets it go

Aravind does it again and for the third time, it's with a full delivery. Seamed away a little bit and Botha got a massive nick. Kartik behind the stumps was jubilant immediately and it didn't take much for the umpire to raise his finger.
pushed out to mid-on again, the two is not on this time
angling in, on a good length, pushed to mid on, and Aravind has to do his own fielding
full again from Langeveldt, this is what he likes to do at the death and its bumped down to long on
slower ball and its a low full toss, played down to long off
here's the Langeveldt we know, goes for the inswinging yorker and there's a hint of reverse as well. Dug out and to mid off
pushed to mid-off, Ab does the fielding
shorter delivery, aims at the head and Taylor doesn't get hold of the pull shot and it's mishit to deep midwicket
fuller delivery, smacked to third man, quite powerful and the call is two again
good running again, putting pressure on the fielders. Botha gets that between midwicket and mid-on and immedaitely calls for the second.
full toss, driven to long off, there's a misfield there and they can run two
softer shot, driven to long on and sets off for the run as he hits the shot
played back to Kohli, not with the force of the first ball, and he does his own fielding again
slower and short of a length, played square of the wicket for the one
Kohli bowls his third. Botha smacks it back to Kohli who does well in his follow through to field
pushed to long off and they want two. Tiwary is doing the tidying up and its a comfortable double in the end
turned to short fine leg
turned to mid-wicket, lots of cries of "very well bowled Kazi" from the 'keeper

not very clever from Johan Botha, left Rahane high and dry. He pulls out the reverse sweep again and hit to AB de Villiers at point while setting off the run immediately. Rahane has said no, but Botha has run past him and is at the none-strikers end when the throw comes in to the 'keeper. Rahane is stranded and has to walk back.
Botha looking to sweep and misses, its down leg anyway and wide is called
turned to mid-wicket
Kazi gets taken on. Rahane makes room and launches it over long-off. The ball seems to have hit the rope but the fielder signals six, fair play indeed.
touch shorter and Rahane is rocking on the back foot and trying to get past long-on but can only get it as far as the fielder
driven to long on again, strike rotation important for these two
pushed to long on for the single
half volley, wide of offstump and well timed. Rahane drives through the covers and beats the fielder to get four
legcutter, short of a length and dabbed to the fielder at point
full and driven and Ab de Villiers runs around from long on to cut it off
whipped to mid-wicket to end Abrar Kazi's first over in twenty-over cricket
shorter again and pushed to mid-off, gentle push really
oh hello! On a length and botha has decided he is going to reverse sweep. Down one knee, powerfully struck. Unfair on the young man
tossed up and turned to mid-wicket
shorter ball, pulled but mistimes to long-on, Saurabh Tiwary fields but the batsmen take him on and run two
starts with a flat one, Botha watching carefully and pushes to long off
fuller this time and pushed to long off, good first over from Kohli
shorter ball, Rahane on the back foot and nudges to long on
pushed to the left of Kohli who puts in a superb leap to cut the runs off
moves onto the backfoot and punches it through the covers
Botha looking to cut but misses
defended back to the bowler
full again, dabbed out to the off side and a single ends the over, what a successful one for Bangalore

What an over for Aravind! Blink and you will miss a wicket. He has kept it full and Dravid looked to smack it to long-off but hit it straight back to Aravind, who had to juggle a few times but held on.
quick and full and Dravid doesn't have enough time to think of what to do with that. He wants to steer it off the face of the bat but ends up being beaten
full delivery again and it does the trick for Aravind this time. Watson has smacked this, flat and hard to long-off. It was straight down AB de VIlliers' throat and he gobbled that up.
full and wide outside off and Dravid has to reach a little. pushes it down to deep cover and gets the one
Improvisation. Dravid walks across his stumps and flicks that behind square on the leg side to fine leg. Cute!
smacked past a diving Gayle, this time Watson gets its away to long-off and Dravid is being made to work hard, he runs back for the second and makes it
Watson tries to clip away on the leg side, misses
full toss and it's smacked back to Gayle
carved away past point
fuller ball, need to be dug out and is, down to long-on again
driven down to long on, Gayle continuing
Dravid makes some room and gets that to point
throws his bat at that one, gets an outside edge to third man
bigger! and better! Smacked into the stands over long-on. It was the slot and Watson got under it and launched.
short ball, flat batted to deep mid-wicket, it;s gone very high again and Kaif tried to make ground to cut it off but couldn't
clipped to mid-wicket and Kohli picks up and has a shy at the bowler's end. Had he hit, Dravid might have been gone again
guided to third man
Watson looking to slog sweep and he gets an inside edge onto hsi thigh pad which pops up and that could have been a chance for the keeper
worked off the back foot to square leg
short ball and Dravid mistimes the cut shot to short cover
flatter delivery, steered to short third man
whipped to long-on, on the pads from Gayle
clasically beautiful. Dravid greets Gayle with a drive off the front foot, so effective and so stunning, Dravid makes room for himself and pierces the gap
that's gone high and handsome! Shane Watson launches the length ball over long-on, big, big shot, lots of legs on it
fuller and slower, played back to the bowler
touch slower, Watson gets a bottom edge that rolls to the leg side

Missed run-out chance  Virat Kohli almost had the opportunity to run Dravid out, back of a length ball, dabbed into to point and Dravid set off immediately. He had a lot of ground to cover at the bowler's end and had Kohli hit he would have been out.
full again, driven to mid-on
and it's worked. Full delivery, Dravid steps out a little, gets a good stride in and bdrives through point beautifully, stunning shot that.
full again, Watson drives back to Zak and it's another decent over
pushed into the off side, scrambled ran taken
full and Dravid gets under it, chips it over the head of mid-on, not greatky timed but it beats the fielder to the boundary
goes for a more delicate touch now and plays down to third man, just the one
full again and Watson drives down the ground, mid-off is there again to collect, he just can't get it through can he?
Zak bowling his third over and it's full outside off and guided to third man
straight again, and Watson cuts with a little more purpose, he does make good contact but point is there to collect, good come back from Langeveldt after starting with a no-ball
straighter from Langeveldt, Watson wants to drive and he does so on the front foot, only as far as mid-off
steered into the gap behind point, third man cleans up
no footwork from Dravid and no timing. Cuts to point but no further
much, much better. Gets the smallest hint of swing and beats the outside edge
wide of offstump, fairly shortish but Dravid has to reach for it and he can only get it as far as the inner ring. Wasted free hit
starts off with a no-ball, that's quite some overstep, a good few centimetres from the line
full this time and pushed to mid-on as Dravid keeps strike
On legstump line. Dravid is looking to whip away through mid-wicket but the ball can only thud into his pads.
Zak pulls the length back a tad. Pushed to mid-on.
and now the other side of the wicket. On the pads, flicked past mid-on. Trademark Dravid.
what a stylish way to get off the mark. Dravid uses his wrists so well and drives that length ball past point
ooohhh, Dravid almost plays on. Looks to run it down to third man, but is very close to chopping it on.
pushed to point. AB finishes off by saying that he is pleased that Mark Boucher is in the IPL. Boucher is at KKR, of course.
short from Aravind and he pays for that. Watson is on the front foot and pulls to deep mid-wicket.
worked through mid-on. AB saying that he enjoys the fielding very much
Now we've got proper contact. Slightly overpitched and driven over long off, one bounce and it's four. Watson keeps himself so still when we plays that.
length ball, pushed back to the bowler. AB de Villiers is on the mic says he "doesn't know why management rate him as a good fielder."
Srinath Aravind shares the new ball and he starts off well. Watson looks to go over mid-on but can't get it away, mistimed instead
good first over from Zak. Keeps bowling a tight line, on offstump and Dravid defends.
swings back into Watson this time, he is still looking for a big shot and manages to turn this one to fine leg, he probably played that a bit late, not reading it too well at the moment
Fuller this time and Watson looks for the drive, gets an outside edge that runs down to third man for a couple
straight delivery, Watson wants to flick away on the leg side, but doesn't make any contact and the ball hits the pads and rolls away
back of a length and pushed to point. Bangalore showing a lot of commitment in the field.
Just down the leg-side from Khan. Arun Kartick is behind the stumps and he collects. AB de Villiers is in the outfield.
Watson immediately starts with a smack. It moves away a little and he bludgeons it to the point fielder. That's as far as it will get though.
the stand in skipper finishes it for Bangalore. Kohli goes down town and pulls of deep square leg. Bangalore win their sixth match in a row and have not lost a match since Gayle joined them.
pushed to point, Kohli wants one but decides against it
delicate and elegant from Kohli, clipped away through mid-wicket, such an amazing contrast to the bludgeoning Gayle.
stroked through the covers, Bangalore one shot away now
Gayle looking to slap this through the covers and misses, he knows he needs just two more shots
clipped off the hips to deep mid-wicket
Gayle wants this over and he wants it over quick. Swings over deep mid-wicket to score his 30th six of this IPL season. Eight left to get now.
turned to short fine leg
pushed to long on
off the backfoot from Kohli and Ross Taylor can't save another, it goes through his legs for four on the cover boundary
Kohli hit on the pads, may have been an inside edge
crunched through extra cover, Taylor does well to cut it off on the boundary
swept to the backward square leg boundary and that is Shane Warne's last ball at Jaipur. He walks back with a hint of a tear in his eye. Rajasthan has enjoyed you, Warney.
the respect has ended as Gayle decides he has had enough, it's time to put it away. Warne tossed it up and Gayle dispatched it over long off
cut off the backfoot to mid off
flatter and outside off, Gayle slashes and misses
steered to the short third man
shortish ball and chipped into the covers
turned to mid-wicket and it does look as though Bangalore are quite happy to get the runs in ones
gentle nudge to long off, no boundary off this over yet
defensive push to mid-wicket
driven to long off, still only one and that really is enough
played back to the bowler
pushed into the covers, Menaria comes into the attack
Kohli wants to smack now, crunches it through the covers, not a great over from Taylor, 11 from it
pushed to long on and it's an easy one again
tossed up, Gayle goes big to bring up his 50, sends the ball sailing over long-on, lots of power in that shot
off the back foot this time, there is so much space out there to play the ball away for a single
turned to backward square leg
gives it a good bit of air, pushed through the covers
Botha finishes decently, Gayle defends back to him, it's been a costly four overs from the South African
tossed up again, Kohli gets hold of it and hits on the bounce to long on
turned to mid-wicket, that area is protected
tosses it up and Gayle could have done more with that, chops it down beside the pitch and ambles through for one
dabs it down to mid off where Botha has to run to clean up after himself
Botha starts his last over and he gets smacked around again, Kohli picks up easily and lofts to long off
played square of the wicket and Warne has completed another fantastic over, almost time to say goodbye to Jaipur
quicker ball, chopped to third man
flighted and pushed to mid on
Kohli counters the turn this time and drives in the air to cover, the fielder does well to get to the ball, looks like he may have dropped it, actually.
sharply turning legbreak and Kohli looks to cut, but misses, could have easily got a bottom edge and been caught behind
slapped down to long off, Shane Warne continuing
pushed to deep mid-wicket, Gayle keeps strike. Halfway in terms of overs and more than half the runs have been scored already
bangs it in short, Kohli has to reach quite high for the pull shot but gets it to midwicket, there's time for two but they settle for one
angling into Gayle again, helps it on its way and pushes to midwicket
angles into Gayle and he pushes to point, he thinks about the run but is sent back
slower ball, turned to mid-wicket
smacked into the pitch, Kohli looking to drive that off the back foot but not getting hold ot it
turns away from Kohli who reaches out and cuts to cover
googly now and Gayle comes down the track to turn it into a full toss, flicks to midwicket
turns in from outside off stumps, Gayle watches it through
makes a bit of room and drives past the short cover fielder, only gets the one
pushed to point
warne tries the flipper, Gayle gets the slightest hint of bat on it, and its struck very fine, trickles away for four
Watto thought he might have had Kohli. The ball nipped back sharply and there was a little inside edge onto the pads
pushed to long off
touch shorter and Gayle decided this is the one to hit. Clobbered through mid-on, casual as you like
straight again and pushed to long on, the required run rate is less than a run a ball, by the way
too much effort from Watto, drifts down the leg side and it's wide
little bit of width and Gayle hits on the toe end of the bat to long off
straight and Kohli flicks it to mid-wicket to give Gayle strike
wide outside off and swatted to Taylor at mid off who makes a good stop. Gayle studies his bat in disgust
nice and wristy from Kohli, turned to long off

He's got one! Fairly short from Warne and Dilshan goes on the slog sweep, He's got hold of it but Ross Taylor at deep mid-wicket has it covered. He timed the jump well, was careful not to step on the boundary and completed a fine catch. Liz Hurley and Shilpa high five
steered to backward point
turned square of the wicket and they get a couple
on the money, immediately, defended back to Warne
flatter one, pushed to long on
now Dilshan goes for it. Gets under it but doesn't get enough on it. One bounce and over the long-off fence
Gayle gets forward, balls comes off the pads and it's a leg bye
quiet this time, just a defensive prod from Gayle
Gayle goes big! Makes a good deal of room and hits it long and high over long off.
Botha continues, whipped to mid-wicket for one, Raut hits the stumps at the bowler's end and there are four overthrows to be had, totally unncessary from Rajasthan
full and straight and Dilshan gets under it and spanks to mid-on but can't get it away
gets it straight now and Dilshan defends
oh dear, there are problems for Rajasthan. Trivedi persists in bowling it outside off and Dilshan will have it again, through the covers, races away and the 50 is up
this time its through, short and wide again and Dilshan stands and smacks through the covers, he won't let three of those go to waste
better from Trivedi, straighter and Dilshan is stll looking to bash, only gets it back to the bowler
short and wide and Dilshan had to reach for it, he makes contact but its more of a swat than anything else, finds the fielders in the covers

Dropped  Gives it some air again and Gayle lifts it to mid-off, where Warne is fielding. The ball goes through his hands and it's turning into an unpleasant last game for the Australian. If that's not bad enough, it's also four.
Gayle is happy to defend, pushes it into the off side
pushed past Botha, who dives to his left, can't stop the one
too easy for DIlshan, picks it up and sweeps through backward square leg, Botha gave it some air and was punished
worked to mid-wicket, laboured stroke from Gayle, gets one
flat and straight and Gayle defends off the front foot
more than 10 runs off this over. Dilshan seems in a hurry to join up with his Sri Lankan teammates and pulls this to deep mid-wicket. Too short from Pankaj
takes a step forward and has a big swish, but misses, could easily have been bowled and the keeper doesn't collect well, Dilshan sees it and calls Gayle through for one
short of a length and easy to pull, Gayle doesn't move his feet much, just rocks back a touch and sends that away for four, powerful shot
makes room again, almost too much room and hits it cross batted to mid off
Gayle makes some room for himself and spanks it to mid-on. Warne misfields and allows the double
Pankaj Singh gets the ball now, starts with a short one and Dilshan rolls the wrists as he plays the pull shot to deep backward square leg
no luck for Botha either in his first over. Gayle picks that up effortlessly and dispatches it through mid-wicket, 20 off the first two
driven to long on for the single
drifting in, Dilshan uses the turn, gets an under edge, fine, very fine and the angle is so tight that no one can stop that reaching the fine leg fence
keeps it straight and Dilshan pushes on the off side
Gayle shimmies down the track and nudges that to short mid wicket, runs quickly to get one
starts with one that angles in, Gayle defends
undoes all the good work now. Too full and too easy for Dilshan to cream that to deep extra cover. Good start for Rajasthan
very close there, shapes away and Dilshan follows the line of the ball, could have easily been an edge
width on offer again, Dilshan cuts, straight to point
better from Watson, straighter and beats the bat
half-volley from Watson, the cover fielder is up and Dilshan only had to beat him to get four and he did, no foot movement, stand and deliver stuff
too far outside off, and called wide
drifting into the pads and played off them to mid-wicket. Bit of swing for Watto
